name: page-sections
goal: Pages expose Uses but no Used In tab or section; existing Used In links open Overview.

evidence: Pages should expose Overview, Contract, Uses, States, History and Source only. Existing page Used In URLs should open Overview while preserving branch/commit; other entity kinds retain Used In.

Standardized usage, details and visual-overview tests explicitly require Used In for pages. Strengthen those existing tests for category-specific navigation, direct page Used In inputs, canonical addresses, current/history and all three browser widths; retain non-page consumer coverage.
